items.title: JAPAN SSW TRAINING CENTRE
items.subtitle: Empowering the Bangladeshi Workforce for Success in Japan
items.description: The Kawaii Group is committed to addressing Japan's labor shortage by establishing the JAPAN SSW TRAINING CENTRE in Bangladesh. Despite strong bilateral relations, Bangladesh faces challenges in providing practical training and language development for the Japanese job market. This initiative aims to bridge that gap by preparing approximately 50,000 skilled workers over the next decade, enhancing their competitiveness in the Specific Skilled Workers (SSW) sector.

items.title: Japan Business Tower
items.subtitle: Premier Destination for Shopping, Dining, and Business Excellence
items.description: The Japan Business Tower at Panchdona is a prime business destination located in the prestigious area of Panchdona More, Narsingdi, covering 42.42 katha (30,542 square feet). This thoughtfully designed complex offers a range of facilities, including a shopping mall with a super shop and food court, modern office spaces, and a cineplex.

items.title: Japan Green City
items.subtitle: Embrace Japanese Inspired Luxury in Dhaka
items.description: Japan Green City, Dhaka's premier residential complex, located in the prestigious Vatara-Gulshan area. Offering spacious and well-appointed apartments amidst lush greenery, this environmentally friendly development ensures convenience, connectivity, and a peaceful atmosphere. With top-tier amenities including playgrounds, swimming pools, and a vibrant community spirit, Japan Green City is the ideal choice for families and young couples seeking a safe and prestigious place to live.

items.title: Japan Business Center
items.subtitle: For Premier Experience and Business Excellence
items.description: The Japan Business Center in Vatara, Gulshan, Dhaka, is an iconic development spread across 8 bighas or 3237.49 Tsubo of prime land. This state-of-the-art facility will include a shopping mall, super shop, food court, modern office spaces, a five-star hotel, and essential healthcare amenities like a clinic and gym. It also features a dedicated mosque, ample parking, and a focus on community and green spaces, offering a blend of luxury, convenience, and tranquility in the heart of Dhaka.

items.title: Kawaii Group-Bureau of Manpower Employment and Training (BMET) MOU Signing Ceremony
items.desc: BMET partnered with Kawaii Group to enhance workforce readiness for Japan's Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) program. Kawaii Group's extensive experience and strong presence in Japan make it a key player in facilitating smooth migration and employment for Bangladeshi workers.

items.title: Japanese Food and Traditional Green Tea Ceremony
items.desc: On February 21st, International Mother Language Day, Achieve Japan hosted a Japanese Food and Traditional Green Tea Ceremony attended by Japan Foundation representatives including Ms. Kyoko Takemoto, Mr. Okubo, Mr. Kasai, and officials from JF KC in Osaka. Students demonstrated Japanese culinary traditions and cultural values. Discussions covered Bangladesh's current Japanese language training landscape, the impact of enhanced teacher training methods, IRODORI materials' significance, and strategic approaches to SSW program advancement. The Japan Foundation pledged comprehensive support for Achieve Japan's development initiatives.

items.title: Kawaii Group-Egrowth Inc. MOU Signing Ceremony
items.desc: On December 17th, during the Japan Day event organized by BASIS: Japan Desk, Kawaii Advanced Technology & Solution Ltd participated as a Gold Sponsor. As part of the event, the company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Egrowth, aiming to create new opportunities in IT engineer training and job placement. This collaboration marks a step forward in strengthening global tech talent exchange and workforce development.

privacy.intro: Kawaii Group ("us", "we", or "our") operates the website www.kawaiibd.com (the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect personal information when you visit our website, contact us, register for events, apply for opportunities, or otherwise interact with our Service. It also describes the choices and rights available to you.

sections.overviewText: Kawaii Group Bangladesh is a Japan-Bangladesh joint venture committed to building trust with clients, partners, students, job seekers, and website visitors. Protecting personal information is part of that commitment. We process data only for clear business purposes related to our services in education, human resources, recruitment, manufacturing support, technology, and cross-border collaboration.
sections.overviewText2: By using our Service, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with our practices, please discontinue use of the Service and contact us with any questions before sharing personal information.
sections.infoCollectIntro: We collect several types of information to operate and improve our Service. The information we receive depends on how you interact with us — for example, browsing pages, submitting inquiry forms, registering for a masterclass or seminar, applying for career opportunities, or communicating by email or phone.
sections.infoCollectIntro2: We may collect information directly from you, automatically through your device and browser, and from trusted partners when needed to fulfill a request you initiated (such as event registration confirmation or recruitment coordination).
sections.personalDataIntro: Personal Data means information that can identify you as an individual. Depending on the form or service you use, this may include:
personalItems: Full name and preferred form of address
Postal or office address, city, and country
Company name, designation, and professional background
Education, skills, language ability, and career preferences (when you apply or request counseling)
Messages, attachments, and details you voluntarily submit through contact or registration forms
sections.personalDataOutro: Please provide only accurate information and avoid sharing sensitive data that is not required for your request. If you submit information on behalf of another person, you confirm you have authority to do so.
sections.usageDataText: We may automatically collect technical and usage information when you access the Service. This can include your IP address, browser type and version, device type, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, time spent on pages, approximate location derived from IP, and diagnostic logs that help us understand performance and security.
sections.usageDataText2: Usage Data helps us improve navigation, fix errors, measure content usefulness, protect against abuse, and understand aggregated traffic patterns. We do not use Usage Data alone to make decisions about you that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
sections.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the website, remember preferences, measure traffic, and improve user experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though disabling some cookies may affect site functionality.
sections.cookiesText2: Where we use analytics tools such as Google Analytics, those providers may process technical identifiers and usage metrics according to their own privacy policies. We configure analytics to support site improvement and audience understanding.
cookieItems: Essential cookies required for core site features and security
Preference cookies that remember language or interface choices
Analytics cookies that help us understand how pages are used in aggregate
Performance cookies that support diagnostics and reliability monitoring
sections.whyCollectIntro: We use collected information for legitimate business and service purposes, including:
whyItems: To provide, maintain, and improve the website and related digital services
To respond to inquiries, partnership requests, and customer support messages
To process event, seminar, and masterclass registrations and send related updates
To evaluate career or education inquiries and coordinate follow-up where appropriate
To send service communications you request or that are necessary for a transaction
To analyze aggregated usage trends and improve content, accessibility, and performance
To detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, or unauthorized activity
To comply with applicable legal obligations and enforce our terms and policies
sections.disclosureText: We do not sell your Personal Data. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate the Service (for example hosting, email delivery, analytics, or form processing), and only as needed to perform those functions under appropriate confidentiality expectations.
sections.disclosureText2: We may also disclose information when required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request; to protect the rights, safety, and property of Kawaii Group, our users, or the public; or in connection with a corporate reorganization, merger, or asset transfer where data remains protected consistently with this Policy.
sections.securityText: The security of your data is important to us. We apply administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect Personal Data against accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. These measures may include access controls, secure transmission where appropriate, and staff awareness of privacy responsibilities.
sections.securityText2: No method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure. While we strive to use commercially reasonable safeguards, we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please use strong unique passwords for your accounts elsewhere and notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized use of your information with us.
sections.retentionText: We retain Personal Data only for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. Retention periods may vary depending on the nature of the interaction (for example, a one-time inquiry versus an ongoing partnership or recruitment process).
sections.retentionText2: When information is no longer required, we take steps to delete, anonymize, or securely archive it according to our internal practices and applicable requirements.
sections.rightsIntro: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your Personal Data. Subject to legal limitations, these may include:
rightsItems: The right to access Personal Data we hold about you
The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
The right to request deletion of Personal Data in certain circumstances
The right to object to or restrict certain processing activities
The right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
The right to request information about how your data has been used or shared
sections.rightsOutro: To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding. We will handle requests in good faith and within a reasonable timeframe consistent with applicable law.
sections.childrenText: Our Service is not directed to children under the age of 16, and we do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate steps to review and delete the information where required.
sections.internationalText: Kawaii Group operates with connections between Bangladesh, Japan, and other regions. Information you provide may be processed or stored in countries other than your own, including locations where our offices, partners, or service providers operate.
sections.internationalText2: When Personal Data is transferred internationally, we take reasonable steps intended to ensure an appropriate level of protection consistent with this Privacy Policy and applicable legal requirements.
sections.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or business operations. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised effective or last-updated date.
sections.changesText2: We encourage you to review this page periodically. Continued use of the Service after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy, to the extent permitted by law.
sections.contactText: If you have questions, concerns, or requests about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact Kawaii Group Bangladesh. We welcome the opportunity to clarify how we handle personal information and to support your privacy preferences.

speaker.name: Dr. SHUNSUKE SOMEYA
speaker.bio: Dr. Shunsuke Someya sits at a unique intersection of academic expertise and field operations. With a Ph.D. in Engineering and license as a First-class Architect in Japan, he bridges technology, field practices, and corporate strategy to lead Construction DX and BIM transformations.

timeline.t1: Takenaka Corporation — Technology Research Institute, BIM Promotion Office, HQ Chief Expert (18 years).
timeline.t2: Ph.D. in Engineering, Shibaura Institute of Technology.
timeline.t4: Digital Construction Someya R&D — Founder & Proprietor.

speaker.academicRolesText: Committee Member of Architectural Institute of Japan (AIJ) VDC/BIM Subcommittee, and Committee Member of Japan Society for Precision Engineering (JSPE).

modules.title: What We Will Cover in this Masterclass

m1.title: Construction DX (Digital Transformation)
m1.desc: Understanding Japan's MLIT standards and the transition from manual, legacy systems to digital-native sites.

m2.title: 3D & Multidimensional BIM Workflows
m2.desc: Moving from 2D CAD to 3D, 4D (Time Scheduling), and 5D (Costing) workflows with Revit, Navisworks, and Tekla.

m3.title: Practical Clash Detection
m3.desc: Techniques for identifying structural and MEP interference issues before fabrication, saving millions in rework.

m4.title: Global BIM Job Opportunities
m4.desc: How Bangladeshi engineers and architects can prepare their portfolios for international and Japanese firms.

kjchs.overviewP1: In Bangladesh, Kawaii Japan Career & HR Solutions is a renowned career matching and HR solutions company. As a joint venture between Japan and Bangladesh and one of the sister concerns of the Kawaii Group, we specialize in developing and delivering tailored workforce solutions. Acting as a strategic bridge, we connect top talent with growing organizations.
kjchs.overviewP2: We began the journey of our company in 2025 with a clear objective: to connect talent with the right opportunities and support organizations in building strong, capable teams. We have established connections with over 60 companies till now, focusing on quality, transparency, trust, and long-term relationships.
kjchs.standardsIntro: We are the first HR company in Bangladesh to adopt and implement Japanese technology-driven systems, focusing heavily on:
kjchs.aboutP1: We founded Kawaii Japan Career & HR Solutions BD with the belief that recruitment is not just about filling positions, but rather it is about creating the right match between people and organizations. We provide services with equal attention and priority to both employers and job seekers.
kjchs.aboutP2: We take the time to understand both employers and candidates, because we believe that every organization is unique and every individual has unique potential. We provide the full range of solutions related to recruitment, staffing, HR, IT, legal, and sustainability that a company needs.
kjchs.visionText: Our goal is to become a trusted human resources and career solutions partner not only in Bangladesh but globally. We want to be known as the best for creating meaningful and lasting connections between organizations and talent.
kjchs.missionText: Our mission is to provide reliable and customized HR solutions that help organizations grow and individuals develop their careers. We strive to maintain transparency, professionalism, and consistency in everything we do.
kjchs.employersDesc: We help organizations in building strong, efficient, and effective teams. Our goal is to reduce hiring time, improve candidate quality, and support business growth through reliable workforce solutions.

kjchs.employerExpertise: We understand that every organization has unique and different hiring needs and requirements. Our expertise lies in identifying the candidates who not only meet the job requirements but also fit the company's culture and long-term goals. We work across a variety of industries and focus on maintaining a well-organized and efficient recruitment process.
kjchs.employerPhilosophy: We believe that the success of an organization depends on the quality of its employees. That's why we focus on building strong connections between companies by finding the right talent.
kjchs.employerProcessIntro: Our process is designed to make the hiring process simple and effective.

whyChooseSection.excellenceBody: Excellence drives every part of our business. We maintain high standards across every company in the group. We focus on quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction so partners receive dependable results. Every client receives professional support. Every project receives dedicated attention. Every partnership reflects our commitment to trust, transparent communication, and long-term success for communities connected through Japan-Bangladesh opportunity.

hero.subtitle: A diversified business group with strong expertise in manufacturing, apparel, textiles, trading, technology, education, and international workforce solutions. Building lasting value since 1987.

intro.p1: Our journey began with a clear purpose — to build businesses that create lasting value. Today, our companies serve clients across multiple industries. Every business follows the same commitment to quality, integrity, and customer satisfaction.
intro.p2: We believe every partnership deserves trust and transparency. Our experienced team works with precision and care. We focus on quality, timely service, and long-term business success.
intro.p3: In addition, we are committed to providing reliable after-service support to ensure continued satisfaction and smooth operations for our partners and clients. From first consultation to ongoing collaboration, we stay close to every stakeholder.
intro.p4: Whether you need manufacturing solutions, recruitment support, business partnerships, or educational services, Kawaii Group provides reliable solutions under one trusted brand.
intro.p5: From our roots as a Japan-Bangladesh joint venture to our expansion into global markets, we have consistently delivered excellence. Our integrated approach helps businesses and individuals achieve their goals with confidence.
intro.p6: Over more than three decades, Kawaii Group has developed deep expertise in apparel and textile manufacturing, international trading, technology solutions, human resource development, Japanese language education, overseas employment support, and travel services. This breadth allows us to design connected solutions rather than isolated services.
intro.p7: Our story continues as we invest in people, strengthen Japan-Bangladesh collaboration, and create opportunities that uplift communities. We welcome partners who share our belief that business success and social impact can grow together.

mv.missionBody: Our mission is to deliver world-class products and professional services that exceed customer expectations. We build lasting partnerships through quality, innovation, ethical business practices, and consistent performance. Every team across Kawaii Group works to connect talent, technology, and trade so clients in Bangladesh, Japan, and beyond can grow with confidence and clarity.

speaker.name: Dr. SHUNSUKE SOMEYA
speaker.bio: Dr. Shunsuke Someya sits at a unique intersection of academic expertise and field operations. With a Ph.D. in Engineering and license as a First-class Architect in Japan, he bridges technology, field practices, and corporate strategy to lead Construction DX and BIM transformations.

timeline.t1: Takenaka Corporation — Technology Research Institute, BIM Promotion Office, HQ Chief Expert (18 years).
timeline.t2: Ph.D. in Engineering, Shibaura Institute of Technology.
timeline.t4: Digital Construction Someya R&D — Founder & Proprietor.

speaker.academicRolesText: Committee Member of Architectural Institute of Japan (AIJ) VDC/BIM Subcommittee, and Committee Member of Japan Society for Precision Engineering (JSPE).

modules.title: What We Will Cover in this Seminar

m1.title: Construction DX (Digital Transformation)
m1.desc: Understanding Japan's MLIT standards and the transition from manual, legacy systems to digital-native sites.

m2.title: 3D & Multidimensional BIM Workflows
m2.desc: Moving from 2D CAD to 3D, 4D (Time Scheduling), and 5D (Costing) workflows with Revit, Navisworks, and Tekla.

m3.title: Practical Clash Detection
m3.desc: Techniques for identifying structural and MEP interference issues before fabrication, saving millions in rework.

m4.title: Global BIM Job Opportunities
m4.desc: How Bangladeshi engineers and architects can prepare their portfolios for international and Japanese firms.
